models_evaluated: GPT-4.1 (LangGraph ReAct agent with EHR-MCP tools)

links.outcome: Agent errors from tool arguments and tool-result interpretation versus physician gold standard
links.effect: Correct tool selection and execution; near-perfect accuracy on all but two tasks; lower on the time-dependent task. Most errors were incorrect arguments or misinterpretation of tool results.
links.quote: Most errors arose from incorrect arguments or misinterpretation of tool results.

links.outcome: Risk of long EHR tool responses exceeding the LLM context window
links.effect: EHR-MCP responses were reliable, but long and repetitive data risked exceeding the context window; no numbers reported.
links.quote: Responses from EHR-MCP were reliable, though long and repetitive data risked exceeding the context window.

unlisted_practices: Custom MCP tool layer for structured, secure LLM access to the EHR database

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an agentic LLM framework (EHR-MCP) using tool use to autonomously retrieve EHR data for infection control tasks on retrospective patient records.
